QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Training Formalities
QuestInfo.0: Speak with Eremos about the next training location.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos claims that visiting the Temple of Time is an important right of passage for every hero in Maple World. According to Surana, it's a key component of the 5th Job Advancement. Visit the Temple of Time and talk to the Temple Keeper.
QuestInfo.2: You've completed the right of passes in the Temple of Time and gained the Temple Keeper's permission to pass through.
